name: LISTCAT.jcl
description:
This JCL job (LISTFILS) performs a catalog listing of all datasets under the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO namespace and saves the results to a cataloged output file. It first cleans up any pre-existing version of the output file, then runs the IDCAMS utility to generate a comprehensive catalog report of all CARDDEMO-related datasets.Key Functionalities:
Deletes any pre-existing version of the catalog listing output file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT) to ensure a clean run before generating a new report.
Executes the IDCAMS utility to perform a LISTCAT operation at the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO level, retrieving ALL catalog attributes (including allocation, statistics, and association details) for every dataset under that qualifier.
Saves the complete catalog listing report to a newly cataloged sequential output file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT) with fixed-block format, 133-byte record length, for review or archival purposes.
The IDCAMS step runs conditionally only if the previous cleanup step completed successfully (condition: COND=(0,NE)), ensuring the report is generated only when the environment is properly prepared.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The LISTFILS job has been initiated for the CardDemo application AND the catalog listing report file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT may or may not already exist on the system
Acceptance_Criteria.When: STEP01 begins execution as the first step of the job with no conditions restricting its execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The catalog listing report file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT must be deleted regardless of whether the deletion completes successfully or encounters a failure — ensuring no previously generated report remains on the system before a new report is produced

rules.Rule_Name: STEP01 - IEFBR14 - Delete Existing CardDemo Catalog Listing Report
rules.Rule_Description: Before generating a new catalog listing report for the CardDemo application, any previously existing version of the report file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT) must be unconditionally removed. This ensures every job run starts with a clean state and no stale or outdated report data is carried forward.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The LISTFILS job has been submitted and STEP01 (cleanup step) has completed execution
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The return code from all prior steps is evaluated before STEP05 begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If all prior steps returned a return code of exactly 0 (success), STEP05 must execute and generate the catalog report; If any prior step returned a return code other than 0 (non-zero), STEP05 must be entirely skipped and no catalog report is generated for this job run

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Conditional Execution of Catalog Report Generation
rules.Rule_Description: This rule governs whether the CardDemo catalog listing report generation step is allowed to execute, based on the outcome of all preceding job steps.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: STEP05 is authorized to execute (all prior steps returned RC=0) and the system catalog is accessible
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The catalog listing query is executed using the LISTCAT command with LEVEL set to AWS.M2.CARDDEMO
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The catalog query must retrieve information for every dataset whose name begins with the prefix AWS.M2.CARDDEMO, covering all datasets registered under the CardDemo application — no dataset within this naming scope should be excluded from the report

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Scope of CardDemo Dataset Catalog Listing
rules.Rule_Description: This rule defines which datasets must be included in the catalog listing report — specifically, all datasets that belong to the CardDemo application.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The catalog query has identified all datasets under the AWS.M2.CARDDEMO naming scope
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The LISTCAT command is executed with the ALL parameter specified
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The report must include all available metadata for each dataset, encompassing dataset type and organization, creation and expiration dates, storage allocation and usage statistics, record counts and sizes, and access history information — no detail category should be omitted from the report

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Completeness of Dataset Information in Catalog Report
rules.Rule_Description: This rule mandates that the catalog listing report must capture the full set of available details for every CardDemo dataset — not a summary or partial view.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: STEP05 has executed and the catalog listing report (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT) is being written
Acceptance_Criteria.When: STEP05 completes successfully with all catalog data written to the report file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The catalog listing report AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT must be permanently saved and registered in the system catalog, making it available for future access and review by authorized users

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Permanent Retention of Successfully Generated Catalog Report
rules.Rule_Description: This rule governs how the generated catalog listing report is stored — ensuring only a fully and successfully generated report is permanently retained for business use.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: STEP05 has begun execution and is writing the catalog listing report AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT
Acceptance_Criteria.When: STEP05 encounters a failure or error during catalog report generation and does not complete successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The partially written or incomplete catalog listing report must be automatically deleted and must not be retained or registered in the system catalog — no incomplete report should ever be accessible to business users

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Automatic Discard of Incomplete Catalog Report on Failure
rules.Rule_Description: This rule ensures that if the catalog report generation fails at any point, no incomplete or potentially inaccurate report is ever retained — protecting data integrity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: STEP05 is executing and the catalog listing report is being created
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The report file AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT is created and written
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The report must be created as a brand new file (no overwriting of existing content), must be named AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTCAT, must be formatted as a standard print report with each line containing up to 133 characters (132 content characters plus 1 print control character), and must be allocated with an initial storage space that can automatically expand if the report content exceeds the initial allocation

rules.Rule_Name: STEP05 - IDCAMS - Identity and Format of the CardDemo Catalog Listing Report
rules.Rule_Description: This rule defines the identity, naming, and structural format of the catalog listing report produced for the CardDemo application.
